evidence: The Fear and Greed Index showed a sharp 12-point bounce from 10 to 22 on March 5, breaking above its 7-day mean of 13.43 and 30-day mean of 10.17. While the broader market remains in Extreme Fear after an extended period of single-digit and low-teens readings throughout February, such a sudden positive momentum shift from deep capitulation levels often signals short-term mean-reversion buying and relief momentum, providing a mild positive tilt toward BTC closing higher over the 24-hour horizon.
limitations: Fear and Greed Index is a composite lagging sentiment metric rather than a direct real-time order-flow indicator.
Extreme Fear can persist during prolonged macro downtrends without immediate positive price follow-through.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
